presentation.name: Judge a DAX function by the measures that call it
presentation.summary: Judges a user-defined function before it is introduced or changed, by proving each caller still matches the calculation it replaced.
benefits: Reads the function from the project and stops rather than inventing a signature the file does not contain
Treats the blast radius as the work: the function is written once, and every caller moves when it moves
Requires each caller to match the inlined calculation it replaced, and does not stop at a function that compiles
Leaves the business definition on the measure description, and the grain with the caller
Names the callers this folder cannot see when other reports share the model
